title: VPAT-ready focus semantics and token consolidation for charts and dense tables
creator: Maya Chen
description: Objective: Complete an accessibility audit focused on focus order semantics, keyboard navigation, and color token consolidation across dense data tables and interactive charts so the design system can ship a VPAT-compliant bundle. Deliverables include token mapping guidance, an updated focus-behavior spec for data components, interactive prototypes for keyboard flows, and a VPAT draft for legal review.
acceptance_criteria: 1) All dense table variants have documented and testable focus order and keyboard behaviors; 2) Chart interactive controls (legend, datapoint tooltips, zoom/pan) support keyboard activation and visible focus outlines at AA contrast; 3) Token consolidation results in a single semantic token map for 'control-border', 'control-focus', 'data-series-contrast' with fallback values and migration notes; 4) VPAT draft created and reviewed by Accessibility SME; 5) Regression tests and example pages added to the component docs.
tasks: Run component-level audit for tables: row selection, cell focus, header navigation, multi-select keyboard flows
Design and prototype keyboard-first interactions for charts: legend focus, series toggles, keyboard tooltip activation
Create consolidated token proposal and mapping sheet (old token -> semantic token -> contrast target)
Implement temporary CSS utility for focus-visible outlines aligned to token values for testing
Author VPAT draft and attach evidence artifacts (benchmarks, test scripts, screenshots)
Coordinate with Engineering to add automated a11y checks for focus order and contrast in CI
